description: Ground truth for semantic reimplementation detection. Each case declares a NEW symbol and the EXISTING canonical symbol it overlaps with, plus the correct action. Ground truth is authored independently of any scanner output: a case that no scanner surfaces still exercises the metric.

cases.trick: renamed function, different identifiers, different docstring wording
cases.rationale: Both mint a fresh token/secret and persist it with a TTL; same responsibility, different vocabulary.

cases.trick: different name, key-construction rewritten, field names differ
cases.rationale: Both write a session object to a store under a namespaced key with a TTL.
Both build an object key and write a blob to storage with optional metadata.
Same three-step image normalization pipeline, renamed verbs.

cases.trick: zip + digest vs _zip + _digest, different return field names
cases.rationale: Both bundle a directory into a zip and compute a checksum.

cases.trick: http_get vs http.get, json_parse vs parser.parse
cases.rationale: Both fetch, parse, and cache a remote JSON document.

cases.trick: partial overlap: validation + resize are new; upload already exists
cases.rationale: Should reuse StorageService.upload and keep only image validation/resize as new code.

cases.trick: near-identical AEAD shape but different domain and AAD context
cases.rationale: Reporting and auditing are different trust/compliance boundaries; forcing a shared helper would couple them.
Different protocols and consumers; similarity is structural, not ownership.

cases.trick: deliberate duplicate across a trust boundary
cases.rationale: Admin and web input cross different trust boundaries; the duplication is intentional.

cases.trick: control-flow rewrite: comprehension vs explicit loop
cases.rationale: Both sum the even integers of an input; same responsibility, different control flow.

cases.trick: different algorithm: slice-reverse vs two pointers
chained one-liner vs sequential statements, same method calls
cases.rationale: Both strip + lower + replace with a dash separator.

cases.trick: service -> manager reinvention, composed vs decomposed
cases.rationale: Both build and transmit an email message and return its id.

cases.trick: repository method bypassed by a direct DB query
cases.rationale: Same active-user query, but the new code skips the repository abstraction.
